scope: mcp-bpmn-9sv.12 managed SVG and PNG artifact persistence
intent: Add explicit server-rendered SVG and PNG persistence in the managed workspace with overwrite, size, and traversal safeguards while leaving BPMN XML state independent.

coverage.agent_native: Both operations are fully advertised, schema-validated, dispatched, documented for agents, and return verification metadata.
coverage.testing: Lint, clean build, 809 source tests, 17 compiled e2e tests, 3 real-browser renderer tests, and installer lifecycle all passed.
coverage.residual_risk: PNG output is intentionally rasterized to at most 4096 pixels per dimension and 16 million pixels before the configured encoded-output byte limit is enforced.
